_what_this_is: Canonical board identity, answering PH09-022. Four generators each define what a board is, in four different shapes, and no two agree on the identifier. This is the one record they read instead.
_governing_constraint: THIS FILE RECORDS WHAT THE SLUGS AND NAMES ALREADY ARE. IT DOES NOT CHANGE ANY OF THEM. Every value below was read out of the current repo and is byte-identical to the literal it replaces. A slug is a live URL and GitHub Pages cannot issue a 301; a name is visible text, and visible text is never altered without explicit approval.
_why_slugs_and_names_are_maps: PH09's design made `slugs` a map because one board is spelled three ways across three families and all three are correct - the URLs are frozen. Measured on 2026-08-11, the same is true of GROUP NAMES, which PH09 did not anticipate: Theme 2 reaches published output as three different strings. `The UK Economy — Performance and Policies` (em dash) in taxonomy.json and the notes hub <h1>, `The UK Economy - Performance and Policies` (hyphen) in the flashcards decks, and `The UK Economy` in practice-questions. Collapsing those to one canonical name would silently rewrite visible text on a whole page family. So names are recorded per consumer too, and the differences are data rather than a bug to tidy.
_adding_a_board: Add an entry here (with "notesOnly": true if it has notes and nothing else), create the notes pages and source data, re-run the generators, add the nav entries in templates/header.html. `expectedTopics` keeps build_past_paper_taxonomy.py's loud-failure guard: a board whose data does not match its declaration fails rather than emitting a short taxonomy.

aqa._specCodesAreReal_why: AQA notes use site-local codes 1.x.y and 2.x.y, deliberately not the real 7136 codes 4.1.x and 4.2.x. Ratified in CLAUDE.md, do not 'fix' them. The consequence PH09-023 records is that this puts them in the same namespace as Edexcel's real codes: 37 of 129 codes are claimed by both boards with different meanings, so a spec code is never a key on its own. Always (board, spec).

edexcel-b._notesOnly_why: Edexcel B (9EB0) has revision notes and nothing else: no practice questions, flashcards, glossary, past-paper question bank or taxonomy. board_data.load() and groups() leave a notes-only board out, so the generators for those families never see it; the notes family reads load_notes(). D66, 2026-09-26. The fields below are only the ones something reads - no slugs for families the board does not have.
edexcel-b._groups_why: Themes open one at a time, in publishing order (Theme 1, then 4, 2, 3), each finished and pushed before the next starts. An unopened theme's hub waits in notes-data/hubs/drafts/, which nothing builds. Groups are matched to spec codes by the -theme-N in notesDir, not by position. notesLabel and notesTitle are the two names the notes family shows (a full board's are its practiceQuestionsLabel and taxonomy name).

_pastPapersOnly: OCR has past papers on the site and no notes, no glossary, no flashcards and no question bank. It is not a board in this file's sense - nothing generates anything for it - and past-papers/ocr/ is a hand-written page. Recorded here so that its absence reads as a decision. Edexcel B was listed here too until 2026-09-26, when it became a notes-only board above (D66); past-papers/edexcel-b/ is still hand-written.
_whoReadsThis: Five generators, through scripts/board_data.py's load() and groups(), which leave notes-only boards out; the notes family (notes_sequence, new_topic, verify_page_shell's notes count) reads load_notes() and sees every board: build_past_paper_taxonomy, build_flashcards, extract_glossary, build_glossary and build_questions. Wave 3.2 repointed them one commit at a time, each with its output proved byte-identical. EDITING A NAME OR SLUG HERE IS A TWO-FILE COMMIT: scripts/verify_boards.py keeps an independent copy of all 82 leaves in PINNED, because its comparison against the generators became circular the moment they started reading this file. Run `python3 scripts/verify_boards.py --show` to reprint that copy. Five fields are recorded and read by nothing: slugs.questionBank, slugs.dataDir, specCodesAreReal and each group's names.flashcards, plus notesUrl which build_glossary copies into its BOARDS and never renders. slugs.dataDir is also incomplete - Edexcel A has two past-paper data directories, edexcel-a and edexcel-a-as, and this records one.
